scripts.build:electron: node -e "const fs=require('fs'); try{fs.rmSync('dist', {recursive:true, force:true, maxRetries:10, retryDelay:200})}catch(e){} try{fs.rmSync('.next', {recursive:true, force:true, maxRetries:10, retryDelay:200})}catch(e){}" && npm run build && node scripts/resolve-symlinks.js && node scripts/build-publish.js
